content:
{'text': '演員卡莉·庫奧與湯姆·佩爾菲里如今已是一家四口。', 'paragraph_context': 'Actors Kaley Cuoco and Tom Pelphrey now have a family of four.'}

{'text': '這對夫婦週三在 Instagram 發布帖文，宣布他們的第二名孩子 Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey 出生，並附上多張可愛的新生兒照片。', 'paragraph_context': 'The couple announced the birth of their second child, Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey, in an Instagram post accompanied by adorable photos of the newborn on Wednesday.'}

{'text': '庫奧寫道：「再次經歷這種感覺，無法用言語形容。這是多麼大的祝福。我們非常感激這段瘋狂而跌宕起伏的旅程，讓我們迎來了小小的 Philo！」她並提到寶寶於 10 月 12 日出生。', 'paragraph_context': '“There are no words to describe this feeling once again. What a blessing. We are so grateful for the crazy wild up and down journey that brought us to our little Philo!” Cuoco wrote, noting that the baby was born on Oct. 12.'}

{'text': '這位《荒原》原主曾上演的演員在 6 月的 Instagram 帖文中首次宣布懷孕消息，帖文附上她日漸隆起的孕肚及長女 Matilda（生於 2023 年 3 月）吃著色彩繽紛蛋糕的照片。', 'paragraph_context': 'The “Big Bang Theory” alum first announced her pregnancy in a June Instagram post alongside candid shots of her growing baby bump and her elder daughter Matilda, born in March 2023, eating a colorful cake.'}

{'text': '庫奧在週三的帖文中寫道：「家庭正式圓滿。是時候帶弟弟回家。'}

{'text': '庫奧與佩爾菲里自 2024 年起訂婚。庫奧於同年 9 月接受《People》雜誌訪問時透露，她和丈夫湯姆尚未開始籌備婚禮，並說「或許得先再添一個孩子」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Cuoco and Pelphrey have been engaged since 2024. Speaking with People in September that year, Cuoco shared that she and the “Ozark” alum hadn’t started planning their wedding yet and that “maybe another kid will have to come first.”'}

{'text': '她笑著補充道：「我們打算完全不按常理出牌，這就是我們的計劃。我現在有四隻狗、一個（拜託幫忙照顧Baby），還有一個湯姆——這已經很滿了。」', 'paragraph_context': '“We’re gonna go way out of order. That’s our plan. I have four dogs now, and a [1-year-old baby], and a Tom — it’s a lot,” she added with a laugh.'}

{'text': '庫奧早在 2022 年 5 月接受《今日美國報》訪問時表示，2022 年在《黑錢勝地》首映禮上遇見佩爾菲里時是「一見鍾情」。兩人的共同經理人 Andrea Pett-Joseph 認為他們是「天造地設的一對」，於是撮合了他們。', 'paragraph_context': 'Cuoco told USA Today back in May 2022 that it was “love at first sight” when she met Pelphrey at the “Ozark” premiere in 2022. Their mutual manager, Andrea Pett-Joseph, thought they would be “perfect for each other” and set the two up.'}

{'text': '庫奧回憶道：「我聽到他的聲音，轉過身去，彷彿我的生命也隨之結束，又彷彿才剛剛開始。我心動了。那就是一見鍾情。」她說：「我們立刻產生了聯繫。我確實感覺我認識他一輩子了，但我當時還沒準備好迎接他。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I heard his voice, and I turned around, and it was like my life was over, or just starting. It hit me. It was love at first sight,” Cuoco recalled. “We were immediately connected. I do feel like I’ve known him my whole life, but I wasn’t ready for him.”'}
